title: 第11章 突发奇想第12章 追踪
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 一串符文散发着蔚蓝色荧光，萦绕在珲伍周身，化解了他的下落之势，将他整个人托举了起来，四平八稳地落回到桥台之上。
四目相对。
于是现场再一次陷入到诡异的尴尬氛围里。
珲伍心里不禁冒出这样一个想法。
她以前好像没有这么难杀吧？
“你没事吧前辈？”
宁语非常关切地向珲伍询问着，不过出于礼貌，也并未靠得太紧，保持着两米左右的距离。
珲伍依旧没有说话，只隔着帷帽阴影用怪异的眼神打量着宁语。
这个npc太奇怪了，从初见到现在，她就完全没有一次是按套路出牌，完全偏离了原有的剧本不说，貌似能力也比原来同时期的她要强上一些。
“珲伍前辈，我是密大学院一年级的新生，我叫宁语。”
宁语落落大方地单膝跪下，把密大学院的学徒礼又重复了一遍。
她压根就没有意识到刚才珲伍连续两次想要弄死她，这会儿甚至有些兴奋和激动，因为自己总算是跟来自于那个古老神秘时代的人物搭上话了！
珲伍：“你的星辰术法学到第几层了？”
宁语起身，一脸惊讶地问道：
“前辈怎么知道我学的是星……”
【跳过】
宁语愣了一下。
她有一种奇怪的感觉，就像是刚刚的话说到一半被人掐断了，可实际上她的话是已经完整地说出口了的…
珲伍：“第几层？”
宁语眨了眨眼：“第七层。”
珲伍点头：“那够用了。”
思来想去，他最终还是放弃了杀人灭口的打算。
两个原因。
一是这个阶段宁语的态度基本上等同于“公若不弃布愿拜为义父”
，属于短暂的百依百顺阶段，而且第七层星辰术法的水准还真的可以帮上珲伍不少的忙。
其二就是，纯粹刚正面的话，其实并不好杀。
只能后面再找机会了。
“走吧。”
珲伍撇下一句话，转头朝着古石桥南方行去。
宁语屁颠屁颠地跟在后头。
“珲前辈，您还记得自己生前的事……”
content_en:
A string of runes exuded azure fluorescence, lingering around Hui Wu, resolving his falling situation, lifting him up, and landing him flatly back on the bridge platform.
Eyes facing each other.
So the scene once again fell into a weird and embarrassing atmosphere.
Hui Wu couldn't help but have such an idea in his mind.
She didn't seem so difficult to kill before, right?
"Are you okay, senior?"
Ning Yu asked Hui Wu with great concern, but out of politeness, she didn't get too close and kept a distance of about two meters.
Hui Wu still said nothing, only looking at Ning Yu with strange eyes through the shadow of the curtain hat.
This NPC is so strange. From the first time I met her to the present, she has never played according to the routine at all. She has completely deviated from the original script. It seems that her abilities are better than those of her at the same time.
"Senior Huiwu, I am a first-year freshman at the University of Michigan. My name is Ning Yu."
Ning Yu knelt down on one knee gracefully and repeated the apprenticeship ceremony of the University of Michigan.
She didn't realize at all that Hui Wu had tried to kill her twice in a row. She was even a little excited now because she finally got to talk to a character from that ancient and mysterious era!
Hui Wu: "What level have you reached in your star magic?"
Ning Yu stood up and asked in surprise:
"How do seniors know that I study stars..."
【Skip】
Ning Yu was stunned for a moment.
She had a strange feeling, as if someone had cut off her words in the middle of her words, but in fact, she had already said them completely...
Hui Wu: "Which floor is it?"
Ning Yu blinked: "The seventh floor."
Hui Wu nodded: "That's enough."
After much thought, he finally gave up the plan of killing and silencing him.
Two reasons.
First, Ning Yu's attitude at this stage is basically equivalent to "If I don't give up Bu, I am willing to be my adoptive father."
, it belongs to the short-lived stage of obedience, and the level of the seventh-level star spell can really help Hui Wu a lot.
The second is that, if it is purely head-on, it is actually not easy to kill.
We can only find opportunities later.
"Let's go."
Hui Wu left a word and turned around to head south of the ancient stone bridge.
Ning Yu followed behind with a bang.
"Senior Hui, do you still remember what happened during your lifetime..."
